archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) + Premium SaaS touch

design_philosophy.core: A modern, premium SaaS Real Estate CRM inspired by Linear, Attio, and Notion. It prioritizes function-first minimalism, progressive disclosure, and modular widgets while maintaining a highly professional aesthetic for sales teams and brokers.
design_philosophy.layout: MODE B: 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. High data density, strict scan paths, top-row KPIs flowing into deeper chart/table views.
design_philosophy.surface: Cardless or flat with 1px subtle borders. Glassmorphism exclusively for floating navigation/headers. No heavy drop shadows unless on hover states.
design_philosophy.white_labeling: Architecture must support CSS variables for primary colors, enabling fast white-labeling per workspace.

rules: Overlines must be uppercase with wide tracking.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6 for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border h-screen sticky top-0 bg-surface
rules: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Always pad containers inside borders.
Mobile First: Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile.
Dashboard widgets must stretch to match row heights (h-full).

components.buttons: Flat, sharp or rounded-md. High contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent). MUST include explicitly defined hover text color.
components.cards: 1px border (border-border), bg-surface. Remove default Shadcn drop-shadow. Add subtle lift (-translate-y-1 shadow-md) only on hover.
components.tables: Grid Borders style. Expose the skeleton with subtle border-b on rows. Highly scanable, no zebra striping.
components.kanban: Horizontal scroll container, columns for 'New', 'Connected', 'Hot', etc. Soft background for columns, drag-and-drop support.
components.dialogs: Glassmorphism overlays (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40) for modal backgrounds. Solid modal bodies.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Subtle borders, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary. Use Shadcn DatePicker, Select, Tabs.

motion.entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-in up for lists/dashboards (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1)
rules: Use micro-interactions for feedback on buttons and Kanban items.

icons.usage: Use duotone weight for empty states/marketing, regular weight for dense dashboard interfaces.

auth_background.description: Abstract elegant geometric lines for login/signup split screen.

empty_state_inventory.description: Minimalist 3D isometric house blueprint for empty inventory states.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files. Write all React components using .jsx or .js extension.
Implement full Dark/Light mode toggle utilizing standard Tailwind 'dark:' variants mapped to the colors defined in this schema.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography to maintain a high-end corporate feel.
Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').
Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind containers. Use Shadcn for interactive pieces (Select, Datepicker, Tabs, Tables) but customize to match the 'flat + 1px border' aesthetic.
Kanban board should use drag-and-drop mechanics (like dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd if applicable) with horizontally scrollable columns.
Telecalling CRM component needs a fixed or dockable dialer panel that is responsive on mobile.
Never use generic placeholder images; rely strictly on the provided URLs in this guideline.
